config.label: Factuarea API key
config.description: Factuarea API key. The prefix selects the environment: fact_test_ for the isolated sandbox, fact_live_ for the real company. Without it the server starts and refuses every call with an actionable error.

config.label: Endpoint of the hosted server
config.description: Endpoint of the hosted server. Defaults to https://mcp.factuarea.com.

config.label: Ceiling for a single call, in milliseconds
config.description: Ceiling for a single call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.
